measurement: Database clock from original unknown_since to the earliest healthy GPU grant on a new dispatch, before signed settlement. Includes request pacing and executor pickup.
percentile: nearest rank, sorted value 19 of 20; maximum is value 20
fault: Terminate one real shared PP process on worker 32 after a verified GPU grant; hold host witness outbound reporting until the two healthy traffic classes and the retry probe complete. Restore the witness and require signed settlement and the original four shared targets before the next fault.
traffic: Same dedicated project, fixed 280x70 PNG, one synchronous loop and one asynchronous loop, each paced to at most one submission per second. Async cap of two outstanding tasks; backlog checked every 250 ms. Both use the normal MaaS HTTP endpoints. The original fault request uses the production ingress handler and Higress with a large OCR input.

checks.retry_probe: One actual validation response per UNKNOWN window marked retriable for that request; Envoy counters on the healthy clusters increased by two retries; total and retry counters on both excluded clusters did not increase across the probe.
checks.fallback: Effective shared route did not offer an upstream fallback to an isolated replica.

observer_trace.method: Read-only 200 ms sampling of the observer intent and the gateway evidence file. Only complete optimized windows with an initially restored four-replica route are listed.
